title: Agent launch: omp --agent through the cratylus extension
situation: omp discovers extensions before it applies command-line flags and lets an extension register its own flags; omp discovers agent declarations (a front matter of name, description, model and tools, then a body) for dispatch; the earlier cratylus session extension showed an agent's name and mark on omp's status line.
decision: The one always-loaded cratylus omp extension registers omp --agent <name>. It resolves the name through omp's own agent discovery, the same declarations dispatch uses; appends the declaration to the session's system prompt, its front matter removed or rendered as prose and its body kept; applies the declaration's model and effort; and shows the agent's name and mark on the status line. An unknown name stops startup with an error. No launcher exists outside the harness.
consequences: Independent of the corpus re-cut: it launches any declaration, so it can ship now and launch the re-cut's agents later. Retires the architect launcher and role file in the operator's home.
